## Selected Scholarship

My publications span latent variable modeling, psychometrics, classification, validity, evidentiary reasoning, and applied quantitative research.

This page provides several ways to explore the work:

- signature publications;
- recent publications;
- influential publications;
- publications grouped by research area;
- a complete searchable and filterable record.

## Signature Publications

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

signature_publications <- read.csv(
  "assets/data/publications.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

signature_publications <- signature_publications[
  tolower(signature_publications$featured) == "yes",
]

signature_publications <- signature_publications[
  order(signature_publications$year, decreasing = TRUE),
]

escape_signature_html <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

signature_cards <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(signature_publications)),
  function(i) {

    pub <- signature_publications[i, ]

    doi_button <- ""

    if (
      !is.na(pub$doi_url) &&
      trimws(pub$doi_url) != ""
    ) {
      doi_button <- sprintf(
        paste0(
          '<a class="signature-publication-link" ',
          'href="%s" target="_blank" ',
          'rel="noopener noreferrer">View publication</a>'
        ),
        escape_signature_html(pub$doi_url)
      )
    }

    sprintf(
      paste0(
        '<article class="signature-publication-card">',
        '<div class="signature-publication-topline">',
        '<span class="signature-publication-year">%s</span>',
        '<span class="signature-publication-area">%s</span>',
        '</div>',
        '<h3>%s</h3>',
        '<p class="signature-publication-authors">%s</p>',
        '<p class="signature-publication-source"><em>%s</em></p>',
        '<p class="signature-publication-summary">%s</p>',
        '%s',
        '</article>'
      ),
      escape_signature_html(pub$year),
      escape_signature_html(pub$research_area),
      escape_signature_html(pub$title),
      escape_signature_html(pub$authors),
      escape_signature_html(pub$journal_or_publisher),
      escape_signature_html(pub$contribution_summary),
      doi_button
    )
  },
  character(1)
)

cat(
  '<div class="signature-publication-grid">',
  paste(signature_cards, collapse = "\n"),
  '</div>'
)
```

## Recent Work

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

recent_publications <- read.csv(
  "assets/data/publications.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

recent_publications <- recent_publications[
  order(recent_publications$year, decreasing = TRUE),
]

recent_publications <- head(recent_publications, 4)

escape_recent_html <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

recent_items <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(recent_publications)),
  function(i) {

    pub <- recent_publications[i, ]

    title_html <- escape_recent_html(pub$title)

    if (
      !is.na(pub$doi_url) &&
      trimws(pub$doi_url) != ""
    ) {
      title_html <- sprintf(
        paste0(
          '<a href="%s" target="_blank" ',
          'rel="noopener noreferrer">%s</a>'
        ),
        escape_recent_html(pub$doi_url),
        title_html
      )
    }

    sprintf(
      paste0(
        '<article class="recent-publication-item">',
        '<div class="recent-publication-year">%s</div>',
        '<div>',
        '<h3>%s</h3>',
        '<p>%s</p>',
        '<p class="recent-publication-source"><em>%s</em></p>',
        '</div>',
        '</article>'
      ),
      escape_recent_html(pub$year),
      title_html,
      escape_recent_html(pub$authors),
      escape_recent_html(pub$journal_or_publisher)
    )
  },
  character(1)
)

cat(
  '<div class="recent-publication-list">',
  paste(recent_items, collapse = "\n"),
  '</div>'
)
```

## Complete Publication Record

The full publication record is generated from a spreadsheet and will eventually support:

- keyword search;
- filtering by research area;
- filtering by year and publication type;
- identification of student collaborations;
- links to DOI records;
- links to open-access manuscripts;
- links to related projects, presentations, code, or materials.

::: {.publication-controls}

<input
  type="search"
  id="publication-search"
  class="publication-search"
  placeholder="Search titles, authors, journals, methods, or topics…"
  aria-label="Search publications"
/>

<select id="publication-area-filter" class="publication-filter" aria-label="Filter by research area">
  <option value="all">All research areas</option>
</select>

<select id="publication-year-filter" class="publication-filter" aria-label="Filter by year">
  <option value="all">All years</option>
</select>

<button type="button" id="publication-reset" class="publication-reset">
  Clear filters
</button>

:::

<p id="publication-results-count" class="publication-results-count"></p>

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

publications <- read.csv(
  "assets/data/publications.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

publications <- publications[
  order(publications$year, decreasing = TRUE),
]

escape_html <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", x)
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

make_link <- function(url, label, css_class = "") {
  if (is.na(url) || trimws(url) == "") {
    return("")
  }

  sprintf(
    '<a class="publication-link %s" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">%s</a>',
    css_class,
    escape_html(url),
    escape_html(label)
  )
}

publication_cards <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(publications)),
  function(i) {

    pub <- publications[i, ]

    doi_link <- make_link(pub$doi_url, "DOI", "doi-link")
    oa_link <- make_link(
      pub$open_access_url,
      "Open access",
      "open-access-link"
    )

    links <- paste(
      c(doi_link, oa_link)[c(doi_link, oa_link) != ""],
      collapse = ""
    )

    student_badge <- if (
      !is.na(pub$student_collaboration) &&
      tolower(pub$student_collaboration) == "yes"
    ) {
      '<span class="publication-badge student-badge">Student collaboration</span>'
    } else {
      ""
    }

    featured_badge <- if (
      !is.na(pub$featured) &&
      tolower(pub$featured) == "yes"
    ) {
      '<span class="publication-badge featured-badge">Featured</span>'
    } else {
      ""
    }

    influential_badge <- if (
      !is.na(pub$influential) &&
      tolower(pub$influential) == "yes"
    ) {
      '<span class="publication-badge influence-badge">Influential</span>'
    } else {
      ""
    }

    searchable_text <- paste(
      pub$title,
      pub$authors,
      pub$journal_or_publisher,
      pub$research_area,
      pub$methodology,
      pub$substantive_application,
      pub$contribution_summary
    )

    sprintf(
      paste0(
        '<article class="publication-record" ',
        'data-year="%s" ',
        'data-area="%s" ',
        'data-search="%s">',
        '<div class="publication-year">%s</div>',
        '<div class="publication-record-content">',
        '<div class="publication-badges">%s%s%s</div>',
        '<h3 class="publication-title">%s</h3>',
        '<p class="publication-authors">%s</p>',
        '<p class="publication-source"><em>%s</em></p>',
        '<p class="publication-summary">%s</p>',
        '<div class="publication-metadata">',
        '<span>%s</span>',
        '<span>%s</span>',
        '</div>',
        '<div class="publication-links">%s</div>',
        '</div>',
        '</article>'
      ),
      escape_html(pub$year),
      escape_html(pub$research_area),
      escape_html(tolower(searchable_text)),
      escape_html(pub$year),
      featured_badge,
      influential_badge,
      student_badge,
      escape_html(pub$title),
      escape_html(pub$authors),
      escape_html(pub$journal_or_publisher),
      escape_html(pub$contribution_summary),
      escape_html(pub$research_area),
      escape_html(pub$methodology),
      links
    )
  },
  character(1)
)

cat(
  '<div id="publication-records" class="publication-records">',
  paste(publication_cards, collapse = "\n"),
  '</div>'
)
```

<div id="publication-no-results" class="publication-no-results" hidden>
  <h3>No matching publications</h3>
  <p>Try removing a filter or using a broader search term.</p>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const searchInput = document.getElementById("publication-search");
  const areaFilter = document.getElementById("publication-area-filter");
  const yearFilter = document.getElementById("publication-year-filter");
  const resetButton = document.getElementById("publication-reset");
  const records = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll(".publication-record")
  );
  const countDisplay = document.getElementById(
    "publication-results-count"
  );
  const noResults = document.getElementById(
    "publication-no-results"
  );

  const areas = [...new Set(
    records.map(record => record.dataset.area)
  )].sort();

  const years = [...new Set(
    records.map(record => record.dataset.year)
  )].sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));

  areas.forEach(area => {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = area;
    option.textContent = area;
    areaFilter.appendChild(option);
  });

  years.forEach(year => {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = year;
    option.textContent = year;
    yearFilter.appendChild(option);
  });

  function filterPublications() {
    const searchTerm = searchInput.value
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

    const selectedArea = areaFilter.value;
    const selectedYear = yearFilter.value;

    let visibleCount = 0;

    records.forEach(record => {
      const matchesSearch =
        !searchTerm ||
        record.dataset.search.includes(searchTerm);

      const matchesArea =
        selectedArea === "all" ||
        record.dataset.area === selectedArea;

      const matchesYear =
        selectedYear === "all" ||
        record.dataset.year === selectedYear;

      const isVisible =
        matchesSearch && matchesArea && matchesYear;

      record.hidden = !isVisible;

      if (isVisible) {
        visibleCount += 1;
      }
    });

    countDisplay.textContent =
      visibleCount === 1
        ? "Showing 1 publication"
        : `Showing ${visibleCount} publications`;

    noResults.hidden = visibleCount !== 0;
  }

  searchInput.addEventListener("input", filterPublications);
  areaFilter.addEventListener("change", filterPublications);
  yearFilter.addEventListener("change", filterPublications);

  resetButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
    searchInput.value = "";
    areaFilter.value = "all";
    yearFilter.value = "all";
    filterPublications();
    searchInput.focus();
  });

  filterPublications();
});
</script>
